versions.short: The bill would require the Federal Trade Commission, working with the Food and Drug Administration and the Drug Enforcement Administration, to study how minors can get fentanyl through social media platforms and publish a report within one year. The report would cover how common such access is, the health and safety risks to young people, how drug sellers use these platforms, how platform design and company policies affect access, and what law enforcement and others are doing about it. The Commission would consult parents, platforms, police, medical professionals, and treatment providers, and could redact details that might compromise law enforcement methods. The report would end with recommendations for Congress on how to reduce this access.
